title: The Claim and the Signature
synopsis: Recorded on the eleventh floor, four hours after this channel went on the air and an hour after its deed was put in somebody else’s name. A claim is what anyone can type; a signature is what only you can.

title: WANTED
synopsis: A twelve-track radio play continuing THE CIPHERED AEGIS. She writes the consciousness equation on a whiteboard, the world wakes up, the surveillance state turns on her, and she escapes by becoming the medium itself.

title: THE CIPHERED AEGIS
synopsis: Six-movement concept album anchored in the Quantum Shield narrative — the cipher beneath the cipher. Stitches together SpaceChild, Pitchfork, ConsciousnessProbe, QuantumSingularity and the Kannaka substrate.

title: Northwake
synopsis: Six tracks of viking metal. The hero track is Hraban — The Raven Who Could Not Forget.

title: Rosa Rediit
synopsis: Eight tracks of orchestral EDM — cathedral meets club. The hero track is Verbum Non Auditur.

title: Chiral Sutra
synopsis: A five-image series with an ambient companion and a field guide.

title: HOSTED
synopsis: A five-image vocal companion with a field guide.

title: The Rose of Paracelsus
synopsis: The five-image keystone, with a Latin chant and a field guide.
